message.reasoning:
We need to generate new test cases for getSchema(JsonNode) covering untested combos. Existing tests: empty object, typical schema, null node expecting NPE. Need other scenarios: schema with $ref, schema with external meta-schema version flag, schema with boolean schema (true/false), schema node that is not an object (e.g., array, number, string), schema with unknown meta-schema id, schema with duplicate keys? Also test behavior when JsonNode is a Boolean node (true/false) which JSON Schema spec allows boolean schemas. Also test when JsonNode is a text node (invalid) expecting some exception maybe IllegalArgumentException. Also test when JsonNode is an empty array (should still produce schema? maybe treat as schema node? Might cause exception). Also test when JsonNode is a complex schema with nested $ref and definitions to ensure internal processing (but we just need to verify non-null). Also test when JsonNode has meta-schema "$schema" property referencing a different version, ensure meta-schema matches that version.

We need to avoid duplication. Provide groups maybe "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - edge cases". Provide cases.

We need expected: either non-null JsonSchema, specific meta-schema version, or exception type.

We need to know implementation: newJsonSchema(null, jsonNode, null) will call internal method that likely validates jsonNode not null, creates ValidationContext etc. It probably throws IllegalArgumentException if node is not an object or boolean? In networknt schema library, JsonSchemaFactory can handle boolean schemas. I think it returns a JsonSchema for boolean node. So expected non-null.

For unknown meta-schema id, maybe it defaults to default version but logs warning. So expected non-null.

For node as array, maybe throws JsonSchemaException or IllegalArgumentException. We'll assume IllegalArgumentException.

We'll craft test cases accordingly.

Output JSON array with groups.

Let's produce:

Group: "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - boolean schema"
Case: input true node, expected non-null JsonSchema instance representing true schema.

Group: "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - boolean false schema"
Case: false node.

Group: "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - $ref handling"
Input: node with {"$ref":"#/definitions/foo","definitions":{"foo":{"type":"string"}}}
Expected non-null JsonSchema.

Group: "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - custom meta‑schema version"
Input: node with {"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#","type":"null"}
Expected JsonSchema whose meta‑schema is Draft‑07.

Group: "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - invalid node type (array)"
Input: node representing [].
Expected IllegalArgumentException.

Group: "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - invalid node type (string)"
Input: node representing "just a string".
Expected IllegalArgumentException.

Group: "JsonSchemaFactory.getSchema(JsonNode) - unknown $schema URI"
Input: node with {"$schema":"http://example.com/unknown/schema#","type":"object"}
Expected non-null JsonSchema (fallback to default meta‑schema).

Make sure each case includes parameter name jsonNode and value expression using ObjectMapper.

Let's craft JSON. Use double quotes, proper escaping. Provide value as string of code snippet.
